outputs.jitter_ppq5: Jitter PPQ5, five-point period perturbation quotient (%)
outputs.shimmer_apq3: Shimmer APQ3, three-point amplitude perturbation quotient (%)
outputs.shimmer_apq11: Shimmer APQ11, eleven-point amplitude perturbation quotient (%)

keep_middle.description: Fraction of the recording length, centred, used for the analysis; the rest is discarded equally from the start and the end. 1 = whole recording

f0_min.description: Lowest F0 searched for pulses and HNR (Hz)

max_period_factor.description: Largest ratio of neighbouring periods, otherwise the pair is skipped

max_amplitude_factor.description: Largest ratio of neighbouring amplitudes, otherwise the pair is skipped

silence_threshold.description: Silence threshold for HNR, fraction of the global peak

periods_per_window.description: Number of periods per HNR window
